name: Alistair McGregor
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the aerodynamics of racing cars, fueled by countless hours spent building model cars and meticulously studying wind tunnel data. He honed his skills at a local engineering firm before transitioning to the high-pressure environment of professional motorsport.

As a wind tunnel operator for EKS JC, Alistair prides himself on his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to accuracy. He understands that even the smallest adjustments can make a significant difference on the track, and he approaches each test with a pragmatic mindset, carefully analyzing the data to identify areas for improvement. Alistair's loyalty and reliability make him an invaluable asset to the team, a steady hand in the pursuit of aerodynamic excellence.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the side
physical.description: Alistair has a serious, focused demeanor reflected in his sharp features.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten aerodynamic calculations.
Insists on brewing his own strong black coffee before each wind tunnel session.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses even when they are perfectly in place.
